notes.title: FIRST PERSON MODE
notes.notes:
Due to popular demand, we have spent some time tweaking the first person mode to make it as comfortable as possible, hope you enjoy!!

( Touchpad on Vive and X on Xbox to activate )

Let us know what you think :)

Frankie
